note: All pricing used anywhere in this repository is read from this file. No price is hard-coded in code. A model with verified=false has no usable rate and its cost is recorded as null, never guessed. Supersedes prices-2026-09-20.json, which is kept unchanged so the runs recorded against it still verify. The only difference is the addition of the OpenAI general-judge arm; no existing rate changed. Two same-day manifests are distinguished by 'revision' rather than by editing the earlier file, because runs record that file's SHA-256 and an in-place edit invalidates them.

jev-1.13.0.source: https://docs.typesafe.ai/models -- 'Price (per Btok / per Mtok): $42 / $0.042'; 'Charged per input token. Output tokens are free.' Fetched 2026-09-20.

jev-latest.source: https://docs.typesafe.ai/models -- alias resolving to jev-1.13.0. Fetched 2026-09-20.

rules.source: Local deterministic evaluator. No metered cost.

OPENAI_GENERAL_JUDGE_UNPRICED.source: Placeholder for the OpenAI model chosen from GET /v1/models. Until the exact model id is known AND its published input/output price has been read from OpenAI's own pricing page, no rate exists here: the run records tokens and reports cost as unavailable rather than guessing a rate.
